about: The art bot's queue: the live art tracker's prompts (read 2026-11-05), in tracker order (act, then row). Skipped: EN-01 (acquired), BO-05 (found), IC-01/IC-02/WO-10 (no prompt). A key is <ID>-<n>, follow-ups <ID>-<n>+8dir and <ID>-<n>+<action>; keys in the drafts branch's progress.json are not made again. 2026-11-21: stance rework art added: 35 hero animations (stance entries and shared bending casts, all 8 directions) and FX-11 to FX-15 (ability effects and stance auras); see the Final Wars project doc claude/stance-animation-plan.md.
